name: LAMB
description: Layer-wise adaptive moments optimizer based on Adam-style moments. foreach, fused, and capturable execution are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

parameters.backend_options: forwarded to torch.optim.LAMB when available, otherwise the local implementation

examples.title: Train with LAMB
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.lamb import lamb

model = torch.nn.Linear(4, 2)
optimizer = lamb(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
features = torch.randn(8, 4)
loss = model(features).square().mean()
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
